messages:
rui_sales: Heads-up — enterprise POC failed. They send a single chat export and get 413. Demo in 5 hours. Need a quick unblock. :grimacing:

tara_se: which endpoint/region? can you paste the minimal curl without secrets?

rui_sales: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat (us-east-1). curl --data-binary @export.json. File on disk 1.1MB, gateway logs show 2.4MB. No body in 413 response.

ben_infra: 413 typically proxy limit. check nginx `client_max_body_size`. also some clients double-stringify JSON which doubles size.

anya_sre: ALB is 10MB but our nginx vhost for sales had 1m historically. i'll check and can bump temporarily for the POC.

tara_se: also ask customer if they have inline base64 attachments or lots of emoji/Unicode — JSON escaping can inflate size.

rui_sales: yes, exported images base64 + lots of emoji. they can't use external S3.

ben_infra: quick options: 1) enable gzip on client (Content-Encoding: gzip) — reduces transport size; 2) bump nginx limit to 8m for sales vhost (temporary); 3) have client strip large attachments and send placeholders.

rui_sales: can they gzip easily? their infra is locked down and uses an old curl wrapper.

anya_sre: i'll apply nginx bump for 48h now, monitoring. not a permanent fix but ok for demo.

ops_bot: sys: nginx-sales vhost client_max_body_size changed from 1m to 8m at 16:02 UTC (performed by anya_sre).

rui_sales: tried resend after bump — request accepted (200) but model output cut off mid-sentence. Looks like tokenizer/context truncation.

tara_se: different issue now: HTTP accepted, model truncated due to max context tokens. which model are they pinned to?

rui_sales: "redwood-32k" pinned. Their export, even with attachments removed, estimates ~45k tokens.

tara_se: choices: 1) recommend long-context variant (64k) — ops to discuss pricing; 2) summarization of older segments; 3) embeddings + retrieval to send only relevant snippets.

ben_infra: for the POC, summarization is fastest. client can run chunked summarize locally (4k-chunks -> short summaries) then send summaries + recent messages.

rui_sales: customer concerned about cost and fidelity. they asked if gzip affects billing.

tara_se: transport gzip does NOT change token billing; billing occurs after decode/tokenization.

anya_sre: nginx bump remains for 48h; revert scheduled unless we hear back.

rui_sales: customer will try local summarization + gzip workaround. we'll follow up if they want long-context model pricing. thanks team. :thumbsup:
